# Offline documentation fixtures

`readpboc-worksheet-fixture.csv` and `readpboc-table-fixture.html` are
author-created structural fixtures for deterministic examples, vignettes,
and tests. Their labels and numeric values are synthetic and are not People's
Bank of China observations. They exercise worksheet normalisation and local
HTML-table reading without network access.

These two fixture files are part of the readPBOC package code and are covered
by the package's MIT license. They contain no copied PBOC source material,
logos, or trademarks.
